Not all heroes wear capes - but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!
Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we've contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we're really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.
A bit about the role

You'll be the operational co-pilot for our Canadian team as we build Who Gives A Crap into a household brand in Canada. Day to day, that means keeping campaigns moving, keeping commercial pipelines organised and making sure the day-to-day runs smoothly. It isn't just about updating trackers. It's about the groundwork that makes sure our brand lands locally and our regional commercial milestones get hit.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in
• Coordinating campaign delivery across social, influencer, PR and events, so cross-functional work lands on schedule
• Flagging project blockers early and keeping shared timelines and status documentation up to date
• Being the day-to-day point of contact for our local agencies
• Coordinating the Canadian social calendar with our global creative team and local agencies
• Reviewing global and local content to make sure it feels authentically Canadian and on brand
• Reviewing agency pitches for influencers and giving constructive feedback before they go to the Director for sign-off
• Keeping the Canadian marketing budget tracker accurate, with zero errors
• Working through inbound Canadian B2B enquiries, from bulk requests to reorders
Let's talk about you

You're a details person who loves a fast-moving team

We're launching a new market, which means the work moves quickly and the to-do list changes often. You like having lots of moving parts in play and keeping them tidy. You know when to chase a deadline, when to flag a blocker early and when to ask for help.

You have a sharp instinct for what feels right

You notice when copy, an asset or an agency pitch sounds off brand or out of touch with Canadian nuances, and you can say why. You're keen to suggest local ideas worth testing.

You like to follow the numbers

You're comfortable in a dashboard. You enjoy spotting what's working, what isn't and what to test next, and you'd rather turn a messy report into a clear next step than wait for someone else to do it.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence - us too!
Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we're in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly - that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn't be more proud of that.
Have you made it this far?

If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here's the thing, though - research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don't check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger - and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Kitworks is a Toronto-based brand experience company creating custom kits, branded merchandise, PR drops, influencer kits, packaging and corporate experiences for brands and agencies.

We're growing, we're busy, and we're building out our operations team.

We're looking for a Studio + Operations Coordinator to be the welcoming face of our studio while also playing a critical role in keeping our day-to-day operations running smoothly.

This is not a traditional receptionist role.

You'll be the person who knows what's coming and going, which courier is coming at 2:00, where that box went, whether the monthly program is ready to ship and whether we have enough shipping supplies for next week.

You'll work closely with our Production + Operations Manager and become an important part of the team that makes sure our projects get out the door looking great and on time.

What You'll Do

Own the Front of the Studio

You'll be the first point of contact for clients, vendors, couriers and visitors.
• Receive and sign for incoming deliveries
• Check incoming shipments and ensure they get to the right place
• Coordinate courier pickups and local deliveries
• Prepare outgoing shipments
• Keep track of incoming and outgoing packages
• Greet clients, vendors and visitors
• Answer the studio phone and manage general inquiries
• Keep the front of the studio organized and welcoming
• Help manage day-to-day office needs and supplies

Support Shipping + Logistics

You'll work closely with our Production + Operations Manager to keep products and projects moving.
• Book couriers and deliveries
• Prepare shipping labels and documentation
• Track shipments and flag delays
• Help resolve delivery issues
• Maintain shipping and delivery records
• Help with inventory counts and product organization
• Pull and prepare products for upcoming projects
• Keep shipping supplies stocked
• Help organize outgoing project shipments

Own Recurring Client Programs

Kitworks manages several ongoing programs that ship on a recurring basis. You'll take ownership of the operational details for assigned programs, including:
• Maintaining recipient lists
• Confirming inventory
• Preparing products and packaging
• Coordinating assembly
• Preparing shipping labels
• Coordinating courier pickup
• Tracking deliveries
• Managing returned or failed deliveries
• Maintaining program trackers
• Preparing for the next shipment cycle

You'll become the person who knows exactly where each recurring program stands.

Help Run the Studio
• Keep the studio organized and operational
• Monitor office and shipping supplies
• Order supplies when needed
• Help maintain organized product storage
• Coordinate building or office-related needs
• Support production and assembly days
• Help keep the studio looking polished and professional

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is organized, energetic, resourceful and genuinely enjoys being busy.

You might come from:
• Events or experiential marketing
• PR or an agency
• E-commerce
• Promotional products
• Retail operations
• Hospitality
• Logistics or shipping
• Studio coordination
• Office operations
• Production
• Merchandising

You don't need experience in all of these areas. What matters most is that you're comfortable juggling details, solving problems and taking ownership.

You'll probably be great at this job if:
• You notice when something is out of place
• You love a good checklist
• You can manage 10 things happening at once without losing track of number 11
• You're comfortable picking up the phone and figuring out where a package is
• You don't wait for someone to tell you there's a problem before doing something about it
• You're positive and professional when someone walks through the door
• You're comfortable working with your hands and moving product around the studio
• You care about presentation and details
• Being organized is your super power
• You can switch from greeting a client to dealing with a delivery without missing a beat
• On track and on time is your motto

Experience

• Experience with couriers, shipping or receiving is an asset
• Strong organizational and time-management skills
• Excellent attention to detail
• Comfortable with a Macbook and the Google ecosystem
• Strong written and verbal communication
• Ability to work independently and prioritize
• Thrive working in a fast-paced, changing environment

Experience with ShipStation, Monday.com, Asana, Shopify or similar systems is an asset.

A Little About You

You're the person people rely on. If someone says, "Where is that shipment?", you want to know. If we're running low on shipping supplies, you notice before we run out. If a courier doesn't show up, you don't sit around waiting - you call and figure it out. And if a client walks through the door, they get a warm welcome. You're organized without being rigid, friendly without being overly formal, and comfortable getting your hands dirty when the day calls for it.

Why Kitworks?

We're a growing company where you'll have a real impact.

You'll work alongside a creative team producing exciting projects for brands and agencies, and you'll have the opportunity to grow with the business as our operations team expands.

This is a role where no two days are exactly the same, and that's probably why you'll love it.

Reports to CEO, Director of Operations, with support to other directors as assigned

Location - Toronto based
